about: Targets for basketman realism. Each metric: target and acceptable band for the top division of this FIBA-rules game, severity hard or soft, basis sourced (a published figure), derived (own calculation or scaling from published figures) or judgement/none (no figure found). Sources and reasoning in docs/realism.md.

metrics.description: Spread of true team strength, sqrt(sd^2 - 0.25/games), in win %
metrics.source: EL 0.133 / 0.117 / 0.096, ACB 0.152 / 0.157, LNB 0.158, EuroCup 0.152, NBA 0.150; own calculation from population sd of win % (EL 0.1587 / 0.1448 / 0.1259, ACB 0.1746 / 0.1792, LNB 0.1826, EuroCup 0.1925, NBA 0.1601): EuroLeague 2023-24/2024-25/2025-26, own calculation from the official API game results (api-live.euroleague.net/v3/competitions/E/seasons/E2024/games); Basketball-Reference international team tables, 2024-25 (basketball-reference.com/international/): ACB, LNB, LBA, BSL, Greek; NBA 2024-25 https://www.basketball-reference.com/leagues/NBA_2025.html (secondary reference)

metrics.description: Noll-Scully ratio for a 22-game season: sd of win % over the sd of pure luck (0.1066)
metrics.source: Real ratios depend on the number of games (EL 1.85 / 1.69 / 1.55 over 34-38 games, ACB 2.09 / 2.04, LNB 2.00, EuroCup 1.63 over 18; own calculation of win % sd over sqrt(0.25/games): EuroLeague 2023-24/2024-25/2025-26, own calculation from the official API game results (api-live.euroleague.net/v3/competitions/E/seasons/E2024/games)), so the target is the ratio a talent sd of 0.14 gives over 22 games: sqrt(0.14^2 + 0.1066^2) / 0.1066 = 1.65, band from talent sd 0.10 to 0.17 (1.37 to 1.88)
